title: acrostichum danaeifolium f. lobatum
intro: Acrostichum danaeifolium f. lobatum, commonly known as the "lobe-leaved leather fern", is a type of plant belonging to the family Lomariopsidaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, treat respiratory issues, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve coughs, reduce inflammation, and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Acrostichum danaeifolium f. lobatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
